text: Some members of the coup trickled back only days after the siege, telling horror stories of Obi-Wan Kevin's dictatorial methods. Neophytes were often beaten while blindfolded with Obi-Wan Kevin admonishing them to use the force, use the force. Now, most Americans know Obi-Wan Kevin for the video footage of the bearded, dirty, and wild-eyed messiah on a stretcher
